author: UmbreonMessiah
body:
Looked around, didn't find a topic on this so...

    I'm sure we've all noticed that there has been a lot of negativity recently, so to change it up a bit, let's get positive! I want to hear what you Like about Avicus. This shouldn't turn into a flame war, and if it does, I'm genuinely sorry, I didn't mean for that. Anyways, this is what you like, NOT What you DON'T like. And if you don't like anything, please don't say anything. Positive things only. (Also, lay off the sarcasm when doing it.) 

Anyways, I really like how when playing on Avicus, It feels like I'm playing with friends. It isn't just a server, its a community, that I can actually sort of fit into. Also, this server gave me Nebula. And Nebula is my life. 

    Remember, be Nise.
                       -Hyper

replies.body:
Tbh the community here doesn't seem much better than most other servers' communities i've seen.

But anyways the reason why i've stayed here for so long is because of nebula and nexus, and the gameplay is awesome. Now we all know that the staff hack detection isn't the best but the amazing gameplay outweighs the other cons the server has.
So in short, the gameplay here is one of the best i have seen.
